text.tspan: Share of primary energy that is low-carbon vs. GDP per capita 2024
Low-carbon energy is the sum of nuclear and renewable sources, measured as a percentage of total energy
supply. Gross domestic product (GDP) per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between
